title: VietMed-MCQ: A Consistency-Filtered Data Synthesis Framework for Vietnamese Traditional Medicine Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the distribution of correct answer keys (A, B, C, D) in the generated multiple-choice dataset to identify the overrepresentation of specific options (e.g., Option B appearing 50.3% of the time), and employing randomized option shuffling during inference to measure and mitigate models' exploitation of positional patterns.
